info.syllabusName: Visual Design Tools 2 _ Công cụ thiết kế trực quan 2
info.description:
Description: The course empowers students to master 2 advance tools for graphic and multimedia designers, which are InDesign and Figma, so that they can finalize their layout and interactive design better.

Through practical assignments, students have chances to apply knowledge on layout, colors, typography etc. in other courses along with computers and tools to create and finalize graphic applications.

Teaching method:

Under lecturer’s instruction, through a series of instruction sessions, work analysis and personal exercises, students will be equipped with knowledge and skills to develop and complete a magazine layout and a functional apps interface.
info.studentTasks:
- Read textbook and install software before coming to class

- Complete assignments in class, submit online thoughout LMS or Classroom platform.

- Frequently visit fap, LMS or Google classroom for update instrucions and requirements.

- Actively participate into class, review and comments to classmate works, ask instructor questions, bring into class everyday samples for references.

- Complete homework and other requirements by instructors

- Using laptop in class only for taking note, research and doing assignment purposes

- No talking, surfing, chatting, gaming, facebooking, using phone etc. while the teacher giving instruction.

- Present at least 80% class attendance in order to pass the course.

clos.loDetails: Students have basic experience in 2D graphic, vector-based appliction, bitmap-based application and layout application.
Students have basic experience in Using application tools to create layout, interactive user interface
Students have basic experience in With assignments as case study, students know how to create typography based layout and interactive layout UI/UX
Students are able to Operate and master 2D layout skills to create professional look publication products
Students are able to Operate and master UI/UX design skills to create professional user interactive product
Students recognize the important of layout, composition, typography, and user interface design workflows in the industry.
